I am an old man, 76 years now, and I have farmed this land in Mbeya for many years. The rains here are good and the soil is still fair, so maize grows well if I care for it. I will buy a little fertilizer because maize needs it to give a proper harvest, and I will use improved seed since my neighbors say it yields better. My strength is not what it was, so my sons and their wives help me, and I may hire a few people for weeding and harvest.
